title: Biased Cognition
description: At the start of your turn, lose [gold]Focus[/gold] equal to the number of stacks of this power.
smart_description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1 per stack[/blue] [gold]Focus[/gold].
notes: Counter-type debuff that scales with stacks. Each stack causes 1 point of Focus loss at the start of the turn.
